document.abstract: The animated technical drawing or technigraph is a recent development which has grown out of the animated cartoon. Its chief use is to illustrate by means of motion the operation of devices and machinery while providing in text and action technical descriptions of the same, and in addition it finds a steadily increasing use in other phases of that type of motion picture which is classified as “educational.”
